fields.name: Ember & Spice Grill
fields.tone_notes: Warm, friendly and family-run. We talk to customers like regulars, even on their first visit. Short, upbeat sentences with a little East London charm. One or two emojis at most. Never pushy or salesy. Always say thank you.
fields.halal_statement: All our meat is halal, certified by HMC.
fields.allergen_statement: Our kitchen handles nuts, sesame, gluten and dairy. Please tell our team about any allergy before you order.

recent_posts.text: Our Smash Burger is a little East London favourite 😋 Double beef patty, melted cheese, our house sauce and a soft brioche bun, £8.95. Add Masala Chips for £3.50 and you're sorted. Thank you for supporting our family kitchen. Pop in this week!

Our Seekh Kebabs are minced lamb with fresh herbs and a little green chilli, flame-grilled over charcoal, two pieces for £7.95. Simple, honest grilling, just the way we like it 🙏 Come say hello this week.

Our Mixed Grill Platter is a proper feast 🔥 Lamb chops, chicken tikka, seekh kebab and wings, all flame-grilled over charcoal and served with naan and salad, just £18.50. Perfect for sharing (or not, we won't judge). Pop in tonight and dig in!
Warm kunafa with pistachio and cream, £5.95. The perfect way to finish your grill. 😋
This weekend: a free Mango Lassi with every Mixed Grill Platter. See you Saturday!
Our lamb chops are marinated overnight and flame-grilled over real charcoal. Four pieces for £13.95. Pop in tonight! 🔥

content.text: Hi team, here are this week's 3 quick shoots. Each one takes about 5 minutes on a phone during service. Thank you for all you do.

shoots.what: Lamb Chops (4 pcs) on the charcoal grill, with the sizzle and a bit of smoke
shoots.how: Phone held vertical, about 10 seconds. Get close to the chops from a slight angle. Keep the sound on for the sizzle. Slow-motion if your phone has it. Keep faces out of shot and make sure the grill area is tidy first.
shoots.who: Whoever is on the grill, or anyone on the pass
shoots.caption: Four lamb chops, straight off the charcoal grill. Halal, certified by HMC. £13.95. Come and say hello, we'd love to see you.

shoots.what: Kunafa plated and ready to go out, close-up
shoots.where: On the pass, by the window or under the best light you have
shoots.how: Phone vertical, one still photo plus a 5 second clip. Shoot from just above at a slight angle so the whole plate shows. Wipe the plate edge first. Wait until no customers are in the frame.
shoots.who: Anyone on the pass or front of house
shoots.caption: Save room for pudding. Kunafa, £5.95. Our team will gladly talk you through the dish, just ask about allergens before you order. Thank you for being part of our family kitchen.

shoots.what: Mixed Grill Platter arriving on the pass, then lifted to go out to a table
shoots.where: The pass, at the busiest part of service
shoots.how: Phone vertical, 10 to 15 seconds. Start on the platter, then follow it a step or two. Shoot from the side, not at customers, so no faces or children appear. Best around 7pm when it's busy.
shoots.caption: Saturday sorted. The Mixed Grill Platter, £18.50, made for sharing. All our meat is halal, certified by HMC. Thank you for spending your weekend with us.
